requested: Implement the accepted fixed-delta complete-Query multi-window Context route through the pre-training boundary
preserved: Healthy Planner and Tracker remain frozen
One complete Support produces one fixed delta_z
Prior single-anchor artifacts are not silently reinterpreted
forbidden: No formal optimizer run, privileged fault input, state-dependent delta_z_t, action-chunk tail supervision, or policy-quality claim

source_edits.scope: Proceed through the accepted method to immediately before training

report_write.scope: Update active lifecycle documents and final-gate evidence

dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: Pair-window tensors, rollout collection, persistence, frozen-model reconstruction, and script composition retain separate owners.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: ContextQueryBatch exposes explicit pair/window/history/future/action/anchor/mask fields; all consumers use validated public fields.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: Collector and persistence depend inward on validated data objects; scripts compose public context modules and do not own tensor semantics.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: Support and Query use independent resets; invalid rollout rows are rejected; preflight closes environments and performs zero optimizer steps.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: The schema change is versioned, old schema loading is explicit, and 39 focused/evaluation/entrypoint regressions pass.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Evidence claims causal construction and gradient reachability only; held-out action improvement and healthy-trajectory recovery remain unclaimed.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: Tests pin H/K indexing, first-action provenance, pair ownership, anchors, masks, dtype/device, command equality, and rollout identity.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Masked loss reaches Context once per pair; Planner/IDM receive no gradients; real MuJoCo backward reports finite nonzero Context gradient.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: Dataset schema v2 binds query length and pair-window tensors; checkpoint schema v3 is accepted by the rollout-group evaluation route.

residual_risks: The fault action labels are emitted by the original no-Context fault rollout, so better action fitting does not by itself prove healthy-trajectory repair.
Training uses realized fault futures while deployment uses Planner intent; the existing closed-loop discriminator must measure this domain gap after training.
The first campaign fixes one fault and command, so it cannot establish cross-fault or command generalization.
